items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: Dave Bowman, yes he was a good pianist, a good musician, fine.

ctx.x: Well 'Peewee,' that was Peewee Russel. 'Peewee Russel was merely marvellous with a simplicity and an imagination that were enough to make anyone forget about Benny Badman.' (LAUGHTER).
